ui.subtitle: Find a path. Make a home. Bring the world together.

ui.load_failed: This journey could not be opened. A backup may still be available.

ui.empty_saves: Your next adventure starts here. Begin a new journey to create your first world.
ui.bag_full: Your backpack is full. Store something in a chest first.
ui.empty_bag: Your backpack is empty. Gather supplies from the plants and stones nearby.
ui.locked: Discover more of the world to learn this recipe.
ui.set_home: Your hearth is now your home.
ui.no_placement: There is no room here. Choose clear ground within reach.
ui.build_hint: Choose a piece · Left click: place · Right click: cancel · R: dismantle
ui.need_tool: You need a better tool to gather this.
ui.controls: WASD / Left stick: move · E / A: interact · Left click / RT: use tool · Space / B: dodge · Tab / Y: backpack · Esc: pause
ui.welcome: You found the old survey camp. Speak to Mara beside the hearth.
ui.low_food: You are hungry. Eat something from your backpack.
ui.low_water: Your canteen is low. Gather water at a spring.
ui.grave: Your belongings are marked on the atlas.
ui.retired: This journey has ended. Your world and discoveries remain in the atlas.
ui.recovered: Your belongings are back in your pack.
ui.restore_cost: Offer 8 wood, 6 stone and 2 amber to restore this landmark.
ui.restored: The waystone wakes. New paths are open.
ui.bloom_desc: Plants recover faster. Gardens and wildlife flourish.
ui.ember_desc: Processing stations work faster. Mineral harvests improve.
ui.gale_desc: Travel faster and spend less stamina while exploring.
ui.warden_warning: Prepare food and healing supplies first. You may leave the clearing if you need to recover.
ui.warden_down: The region’s warden has fallen. Your atlas reveals new knowledge.
ui.ending: The atlas is complete, but your story is not. Travelers are returning, the hearths are warm, and the wilds still hold their secrets. Your settlements remain yours to grow.
ui.map_help: Your hearth, waystones, settlements and lost belongings appear here. Unexplored land is hidden until you visit it.
ui.contract_desc: The camp needs 12 wood and 8 fiber. Deliver them for amber, provisions and experience.
ui.contract_done: The travelers thank you. Your supplies will keep their camp going.
ui.fishing: Cast your line beside water. Watch for the splash, then interact again.
ui.rested: You feel rested. Your health and stamina have recovered.
ui.storm: A storm is approaching. Shelter will protect you from the cold.
ui.credits: Created for The Mossbound Atlas · Original art, music and sound · Built with Godot
ui.read_only: This journey is preserved in the atlas. You can view the map, but this character cannot return.
difficulty.peaceful.desc: Explore and build at your own pace. Restore the world through offerings instead of required battles.
difficulty.easy.desc: Gentler enemies and slower hunger and thirst. A welcoming first journey.
difficulty.normal.desc: Prepare for the wilds, learn your enemies and make each expedition count.
difficulty.hard.desc: Dangerous encounters and harsher conditions reward careful preparation.
difficulty.insane.desc: For experienced survivors. Strong enemies leave little room for mistakes.
death.easycore.desc: Return to your hearth with everything you were carrying.
death.mediumcore.desc: Your belongings stay where you fell. Return to collect them.
death.hardcore.desc: One life. Death ends this character’s journey permanently.

npc.mara.dialogue: The roads used to meet here. Now even the trees have forgotten them. Gather wood and stone, make this camp your home, then follow the old trail east to the sleeping waystone. I marked it in your atlas.
npc.ivo.dialogue: A good camp begins with a dry floor and a place for your tools. Build a workbench nearby and you can make copper equipment. Chests keep your supplies safe and let you craft without carrying everything.
npc.suri.dialogue: Warm food turns a difficult journey into a manageable one. A cooking pot makes meat and fish much more nourishing. Bring vegetables and mushrooms if you want a proper stew.
npc.bo.dialogue: Copper comes from the fen’s orange seams. Iron lies farther east, beneath the ash. Build a smelter before you haul too much ore home, and bring a better pick for the harder rock.
npc.sela.dialogue: Field mushrooms and dew gel make a soothing salve. Do not wait until a warden has you cornered to prepare it. Gardens will keep your camp fed while you explore.
npc.neri.dialogue: Light a hearth in each camp and restore the waystones between them. Then we can travel safely again. Put a courier board beside a chest when you want help moving materials.
npc.toma.dialogue: The wardens warn before they strike. Watch their stance, step away from the marked ground, then answer while they recover. A longer weapon is useful, but an empty stomach will undo any advantage.
npc.elin.dialogue: The old network did not fail all at once. Its keepers tried to force every region into the same season. Perhaps a living world needs more than one answer. Your atlas may yet show us how.
perk.forager.desc: Gather one extra plant resource with each harvest.

quest.talk: Speak to Mara beside the hearth.
quest.gather: Gather 8 wood and 6 stone from the nearby woodland.
quest.camp: Make a workbench and place it beside your camp.
quest.waystone: Follow the eastern trail and restore the Brackenreach waystone.
quest.warden: Prepare supplies, then face Old Briar at the waystone.
quest.regions: Explore the other regions. Restore their waystones and overcome their wardens.
quest.meridian: Enter the Hollow Meridian and meet the Atlas Keeper.
quest.free: The world is connected. Build, explore, and write the next chapter of your journey.
ui.searched: You have already searched this place. Its story is now in your journal.
ui.surveyed: Nearby land has been added to your atlas.
ui.grove_offer: Tend the grove: 3 seeds and 4 water
ui.grove_done: The grove is thriving. Return tomorrow to tend it again.
ui.puzzle_hint: The inscription names three currents in order: {sequence}. Turn the seals to match.
ui.puzzle_wrong: The seals remain quiet. Check the order in the inscription.
ui.expedition_desc: An old testing ground lies beyond this arch. Survive three waves to recover its cache. You can withdraw safely; your normal death rules still apply if you fall.
ui.expedition_win: Expedition complete. The next depth is open. Return to the arch when you are ready.
ui.peaceful_survey: Study the ruins: 6 stone and 2 amber
ui.growing: Ready in {seconds} seconds of world time.
ui.plant_hint: Plant a seed, then let the garden grow. Bloom and the Green Thumb skill shorten the wait.
ui.fish_wait: Line cast. Wait for a bite, then press interact again. Moving away cancels the cast.
ui.fish_missed: The fish slipped away. Cast again when you are ready.
ui.request_today: Request completed. Come back tomorrow for another delivery.
ui.trade_hint: Trade amber for supplies. Complete requests to earn goodwill and unlock more stock.
ui.courier_hint: Place a chest and a hearth within three tiles of each board. Restore both regions, choose a destination, then send a shipment. Materials arrive after 30 seconds of world time.
ui.shipment_sent: The courier has set out. Your materials are safe in transit.
ui.shipment_arrived: A courier delivered supplies to your camp.
ui.route_incomplete: This route needs a chest, hearth and board at both ends, with restored waystones in both regions.
ui.route_pending: This chest is reserved for an incoming shipment. Wait for it to arrive before dismantling it.
ui.production_hint: Queued materials are stored in the station. Collect finished batches here. Ember makes processing 25% faster.
ui.queue_full: This station already has five batches queued. Collect or wait for them to finish.
ui.exposure_warning: You are getting cold. Warm yourself near a hearth or shelter.
ui.death_fixed: Death rules stay fixed for this journey.
behavior.charge: Braces before rushing in a straight line. Step aside, then strike during recovery.
behavior.leap: Pauses before a quick lunge. Keep enough stamina to dodge the marked direction.
behavior.ranged: Aims before firing. Keep moving across its line of attack. Wardens fire a spread when weakened.
behavior.shield: Its armor blocks much of your damage. Attack after it commits to a strike.
behavior.melee: Closes in, winds up, then strikes nearby. Back away during the windup and return after the blow.
behavior.passive: Wildlife avoids people. It will flee when you approach.
quest.peaceful_warden: Prepare a restoration offering at the Brackenreach waystone.

release.100: The Mossbound Atlas begins. Follow forgotten roads, make a home in the wild, and reconnect five regions through their waystones.
release.100.world: Five wardens, eight travelers, 30 discovery sites, memory seals and repeatable three-wave expeditions. Choose Bloom, Ember or Gale for each region.
release.100.camp: 143 items, 115 recipes, 41 building pieces, six crops and five regional fish. Queue production, send courier shipments and fulfill 16 rotating requests.
release.100.combat: Four equipment tiers, blades, spears, bows and focuses, nine perks, six charms, food benefits and dodge invulnerability. Face 25 creatures with visible attack warnings.
release.100.saves: Multiple journey slots, automatic saves and three backup generations. Five game difficulties and three separate death rules. Hardcore preserves a retired character’s atlas.
release.100.presentation: Original pixel art with 336 animation frames, six original music themes and 21 sound effects. Five languages, bundled CJK fonts, controller controls, an atlas and a searchable field guide.
